title: Ethereum Whales Keep Buying While ETH Tries To Hold Above $1800
subTitle:
Ethereum has been trying to recover but the move higher did not last. A few days ago the price reached around $1944 but sellers quickly pushed it back down. After that ETH dropped close to $1819 before finding a small bounce. Even with that recovery the market is still moving carefully and many traders are waiting to see what happens next.
One part of the market that is getting attention is whale activity. Large holders have been very active during the recent price drop. Reports showed that two new wallets received a total of twenty thousand ETH with a value of about thirty seven million dollars. The transfer happened in two equal parts.
The same whale did not stop there. During the last three days the wallet collected almost eighty nine thousand four hundred ETH with a total value close to one hundred sixty five million dollars. That is a very large amount and it shows that at least one big holder believes this price area is worth buying.
Still it is important to stay realistic. One whale cannot decide the direction of the whole market. Big investors sometimes buy during weak markets because they expect better prices later. At the same time other traders may still be selling. This is why whale activity should be watched together with other market signals.
Another point that supports the buying story is that more Ethereum has been leaving trading platforms than entering them. When coins move away from exchanges some people see it as a sign that investors want to hold instead of sell. During the last two days this trend continued although the speed of those outflows became a little smaller.
Even with this buying interest the market is not fully strong yet. Short term price action still shows that sellers have the upper hand. Every time Ethereum tries to move higher it faces resistance and buyers have not been able to keep control for very long.
The next price area that many people are watching is around eighteen hundred dollars. If Ethereum stays above this level buyers may slowly build confidence again. A stronger recovery could then bring the price back toward the previous resistance near nineteen hundred twenty eight dollars. If that level is broken then the market could start looking at the two thousand dollar area again.
On the other hand if selling pressure becomes stronger and Ethereum falls below eighteen hundred dollars then the next support may appear around seventeen hundred seventy four dollars. That would keep the market under pressure until buyers return in larger numbers.
Right now the market is showing two different stories. Large holders are adding more Ethereum while the overall price is still struggling to recover. This does not guarantee that the market will move higher right away. It simply shows that some experienced investors are willing to buy while prices remain weak. The coming days will show whether that confidence spreads across the wider market or if sellers continue to stay in control.

[On-chain, there’s an anomalous signal—more honest than the candlesticks]

Last night I looked at on-chain data and found an interesting phenomenon: the exchange’s net ETH inflow has hit the lowest level in nearly a month. What does that mean? People holding coins don’t want to send them to exchanges—either they’re trapped and staying put, or “smart money” is quietly accumulating.

The order book makes it even clearer. In the last 24 hours it’s up 0.4%, and over 7 days it’s up 2.4%. You might ask: is that a big move? In the middle of widespread panic, being able to hold steady is itself a signal.

The key is the FNG index—currently 25, in the extreme fear zone. Market sentiment is almost at the breaking point. Yet ETH didn’t get smashed into fresh lows along with the panic selloff; instead, it held steady right here. Historical data tells me that when sentiment is extremely bearish, it often marks a stage-by-stage bottom. This time, I’m inclined to believe in this pattern.

Let’s talk valuation. From the high point, ETH has fallen 63%. This isn’t a normal pullback anymore—it’s basically in an oversold zone. Has the fundamental picture changed? The Ethereum ecosystem is still there, the staking rate is still growing, and DeFi locked value hasn’t dropped to zero. So what’s propping up this drawdown? Plainly speaking, it’s market sentiment killing valuation, not a problem with the project itself.

From a technical perspective, there are two critical levels: 1767.88 is the lifeline—bulls must defend it. 1884.68 is the short-term ceiling—bears are waiting there. Trading volume is a hard weakness. Muted volume suggests the market is waiting on the sidelines; no one wants to make the first move.

Where will it go in the next 48 to 72 hours? My take is that it will first test the upside. It probably won’t break through 1884.68, but if it can at least touch it, that would show the bulls still have some confidence. The real direction choice may still need to wait for macro signals. 昨晚看链上数据，发现个有意思的现象：交易所ETH净流入量创下近一个月最低。这说明什么？持币的不愿意往交易所送了，要么是套牢装死，要么是聪明钱在悄悄囤。

配合盘面看就更清楚了。24小时涨了0.4%，7天涨了2.4%，这个涨幅你说大不大，但在一片恐慌里，能稳住本身就是信号。

关键在FNG指数——现在是25，极度恐惧区域，市场情绪几乎是崩溃边缘。但ETH没有跟着恐慌盘砸出新低，反而在这里稳住了。历史数据告诉我，情绪极度悲观的时候，往往是阶段性底部，这次我倾向于相信这个规律。

再说估值。从高点算下来，ETH跌了63%，这已经不是正常回调了，基本进入超跌区间。基本面变了吗？以太坊生态还在，质押率还在增长，DeFi锁仓量也没归零。那这种跌幅靠什么撑住的？说白了就是市场情绪杀估值，不是项目本身出问题了。

技术面两个关键位：1767.88是生命线，多头必须守住；1884.68是短期天花板，空头在这里等着。成交量是硬伤，低迷的量能说明市场在观望，没人愿意先动手。

48到72小时怎么走？我判断先往上试试水，大概率冲不过1884.68，但能摸一下就说明多头还有底气，真正的方向选择可能还要等宏观信号。成交量能不能放大是关键，没有量，再好的结构也是白搭。

🔁 Rotation into altcoins is not “flip the switch once,” but a sequence. I observe it in layers: first $BTC pulls, then the baton is taken by ETH, and only then do the altcoins in the second–third tier get their breath.

That’s why the ETH/BTC pair is my working compass for the season. As long as ETH/BTC is sitting in a downtrend structure, I consider talk of an “alt season” premature. I’m waiting for holding the zone and breaking the local downtrend with a retest that they don’t give back.

⚠️ What I don’t do: I don’t jump into dozens of random altcoins “just in case.” Strength comes from focus— a couple of coins with a clean structure and liquidity, the rest—no.

Invalidation is the loss of the retest zone. This is my plan, not a signal. NFA, DYOR. 🧭

#ETH #BTC #Altcoins #Trading #Crypto

content:
🔁 Ротация в альты — это не «однажды переключился рубильник», а последовательность. Я наблюдаю её слоями: сначала тянет $BTC, потом эстафету перехватывает ETH, и только затем дыхание получают альты второго-третьего эшелона.

Поэтому пара ETH/BTC для меня — рабочий компас сезона. Пока ETH/BTC лежит в нисходящей структуре, разговоры про «альтсезон» я считаю преждевременными. Жду удержания зоны и слома локального нисходящего тренда с ретестом, который не отдают обратно.

⚠️ Чего не делаю: не залетаю в десятки случайных альтов «на всякий». Силу даёт фокус — пара-тройка монет с чистой структурой и ликвидностью, остальное мимо.

Инвалидизация — потеря зоны ретеста. Это мой план, а не сигнал. НФА, DYOR. 🧭

July token unlock wave is here—dumping trap or a chance to get in?#BTC 

In July, there’s a topic that you can’t avoid: multiple popular tokens are set to unlock large amounts, with a total value exceeding one billion dollars. Many retail investors hear “unlock” and immediately get nervous, assuming it will lead to a sell-off. They often cut their losses and exit early. But does an unlock always mean the price will drop? The truth is more complicated than that.#ETH 

The impact of an unlock on the market mainly depends on three dimensions. First, the unlock recipient: if it’s a team or early-stage investment institutions with extremely low costs, their motivation to dump is stronger; if it’s community incentives or liquidity mining, the tokens are spread out among participants, so sell-pressure is much smaller. Second, expectations: if the market has already digested the unlock as a downside factor, then when it actually happens, the news is often “bad news gone” and can turn into “good news.” But if everyone thinks it’s fine, it can easily lead to a bigger-than-expected drop. Third, the trend: in an uptrend, unlocks often serve as an excuse for a shakeout—after the sell pressure, prices may continue rising. In a downtrend, unlocks can worsen things and accelerate the decline.

Many people only look at the surface of an unlock and don’t analyze the underlying token structure and market expectations. They panic and sell off blindly, only to end up selling at the lowest point. Unlocks are never the decisive factor for the market—they’re just a catalyst. The real driver is the trend.$BTC

7 月代币解锁潮来袭，是砸盘陷阱还是上车机会？#BTC 

7 月市场有个绕不开的话题：多个热门代币迎来大额解锁，总量价值超十亿美元。很多散户闻解锁色变，觉得解锁就是砸盘，吓得提前割肉离场。但解锁真的一定会跌吗？真相没那么简单。#ETH 

解锁对行情的影响，核心看三个维度。第一看解锁对象：如果是团队、早期投资机构，成本极低，砸盘意愿就强；如果是社区激励、流动性挖矿，筹码分散，砸盘压力就小很多。第二看预期：市场提前消化了解锁利空，真正落地时往往利空出尽是利好；如果大家都觉得没问题，反而容易超预期下跌。第三看趋势：上升趋势里，解锁往往是洗盘的借口，砸完继续涨；下跌趋势里，解锁就是雪上加霜，加速下跌。

很多人只看到解锁的表面，不分析背后的筹码结构和市场预期，盲目恐慌割肉，反而割在最低点。解锁从来不是行情的决定性因素，只是催化剂，趋势才是核心。$BTC

#ETH You’re not getting liquidated—you just don’t know how to play futures.
Let me be straight with you:
In the crypto market, liquidation 99% of the time isn’t bad luck—it’s because you don’t even know how to roll positions.
I’ve seen too many people:
They hold on while it drops, add more when it drops again—then after getting liquidated they ask, “What happened?”
When it pumps they run, treating 10% profit like treasure—then look back and realize they completely missed the big move!
The most ridiculous part:
They got the direction right, yet still got shaken out by a 5% pullback…

Bottom line: you don’t understand what real rolling positions actually means.
Rolling ≠ adding more to go all-in.
Real rolling is: “rolling profits to make more profits.”

How do pros play it? Three words: do the opposite!
While others add when they’re losing, they add with their winnings.

While others run when price rises, the harder it falls, the deeper they go.
Once the trend is confirmed, they only move with the money the market gives them.

Let me share a live trading mindset (remember this):
You have 10,000 USDT as capital, and you think BTC is going to drop.

Step 1: Probe position
First open with 500 USDT, set your stop loss. If the direction is wrong, exit immediately—no dragging it out, no hesitation!

Step 2: Roll the profits
After you’re up 50%, don’t add more capital—add only “the money you made.”
Then take the next step down and roll again—every move is fought with profits.

Step 3: Unrealized profit + hedging
When the market gets wild, don’t get greedy. Lock to protect profits, and the “last-mile” hit comes from a ghost position.
From start to finish—your principal never moves, but your profits grow wave by wave.

Last time, using this logic, I turned 10,000 USDT into nearly 50,000 USDT.

Stop envying others’ flashy moves. They’re just:
👉 In uncertainty, they found certainty;
within emotions, they held the rhythm;
in chaos, they kept discipline.

The market doesn’t care about you personally—it only rewards people who have a system.
Still want to flip your account by going all-in?

First, roll your “gambler’s mindset” out of the way.

## One sentence to make it clear
Iran announced a suspension of the Islamabad Accord, and the escalation of geopolitical conflict directly crushed risk assets.

Guys, a bomb dropped over the weekend. On July 13, Iran directly announced it would suspend its implementation of the Islamabad Memorandum. The stated reason is that the US violated the ceasefire agreement. Put simply, this is a full-on tear in relations between the two countries over geopolitical games, and regional tensions instantly hit the ceiling.

When this Middle East powder keg explodes, global capital markets tremble right away. Iran’s move isn’t just a statement—behind it is the entire energy market and the pricing logic for risk assets. For a state-level geopolitical “black swan,” don’t think it’s just talk. Big capital always reacts faster than retail traders.

## Impact on the market
Let’s get straight to the point: this is an absolute short-term negative for the crypto market.

In the short term, panic sentiment has spread to risk assets. BTC is now at $64,075.43 (down 2.05% over 24 hours). ETH is even worse at only $1,841.31 (down 1.58% over 24 hours). In the medium term, if the US-Iran conflict continues to escalate, market liquidity will be continuously drained, putting mid-term pressure on risk assets. Institutions will watch first and won’t easily step in to “catch the bag.”

## My call
Honestly, I’m clearly bearish right now—guys, don’t rush to bottom-fish. Geopolitical black swans are exactly what you should avoid by randomly catching falling knives. BTC will most likely continue probing lower. If it can hold around $64,075.43, that’s still okay; but once the short side gains volume and breaks through this support level, the downside space opens up immediately. ETH itself is already weak—$1,841.31 is definitely not a solid floor. A breakdown is just a matter of time. Even if rate cuts still need to wait, inflation being contained means the Fed’s tightening “ace card” is running out. Money hates uncertainty. Once the inflation slowdown becomes reality, whether or not there’s a July cut, the macro pressure is suddenly much lighter. ### When AI crushes GPT, but Bitcoin “pretends to be dead” at 63,000 — the logic of this bull run has completely changed

It’s interesting to look at today’s two pieces of news together.

On one side, China’s AI rising star Kimi K3 with 280 billion parameters overwhelms Claude and GPT, topping the programming benchmark with a slaughter; on the other, Bitcoin is hanging by a thread—Coinbase’s premium hits a record, down to 60 straight days of negative figures, while ETF inflows have all but dried up.

**The market is voting with its feet: the AI narrative is draining liquidity from crypto.**

Over the past few months, the AI sector has siphoned off a large amount of hot money—Crypto.com secured a $400 million investment valuation to surge past $20 billion. Even AI computing-power derivatives were traded before they even showed up at CME and ICE. Meanwhile, on the Bitcoin side, Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) still only has a single script: “buy, buy, buy.” CryptoQuant can’t stand it anymore and directly calls for “a clearer buy/sell framework.”

**My core view: the driving force of this cycle has already shifted from the ‘Bitcoin halving’ to the resonance between ‘AI + compliance.’**

1. **Institutional capital is “screening” the tracks:** HSBC has been approved to enter the digital securities sandbox, Bank of America appoints executives with both crypto and AI expertise, and Stripe and Swift compete for payment infrastructure—traditional finance’s involvement with crypto is becoming more “functional” rather than “faith-based.” The narrative of Bitcoin as a store of value is being squeezed by Ethereum smart contracts and the demand for AI-computing-layer derivative products.

2. **FTX payouts are a “two-edged sword”:** The fifth round of $900 million payouts looks like selling pressure being released, but $900 million is only a ripple compared to the daily BTC/ETH trading volumes at the hundred-billion scale. The real risk is that the speed of retail confidence repair is far slower than the speed of institutional positioning.

3. **The “lying flat” of $BTC  and $ETH  isn’t the endpoint, but the start of a split:** Bitcoin is going through low-volume, range-bound consolidation around 63,000, while Ethereum is still waiting for ETF capital injections. But the AI sector has already surfaced new “Perps + prediction market” gameplay—crypto-native financial tools are pricing AI computing resources.

**Prediction:** Over the next 3 months, if Bitcoin can’t hold above 70,000 and break out with volume, capital will further migrate to new narratives such as AI + DePIN. Don’t go against the trend, but also don’t panic over short-term data—at 63,000, Bitcoin is safer than an 85,000 “AI concept coin,” as long as you have patience.

过去几个月，AI赛道吸走了大量热钱——Crypto.com拿到4亿美金投资估值冲上200亿，AI算力衍生品甚至抢在CME和ICE之前被交易。而比特币这边，Strategy（原MicroStrategy）依然只有“买买买”的单一剧本，CryptoQuant都看不下去，直接喊话“需要更清晰的买卖框架”。

**我的核心观点：这轮周期的驱动力，已经从“比特币减半”切换到了“AI+合规”的叙事共振。**

1. **机构资金在“筛选”赛道**：HSBC获批进入数字证券沙盒、Bank of America任命加密+AI双料高管、Stripe和Swift争夺支付基建——传统金融对加密的介入越来越“功能化”，而不是“信仰化”。比特币作为价值存储的叙事，正在被以太坊的智能合约、AI计算层的衍生品需求所挤压。

2. **FTX赔付是“双刃剑”**：第五轮9亿美金赔付，看起来是抛压释放，但9亿对日均百亿级的BTC/ETH交易量而言只是涟漪。真正的风险在于：散户信心修复的速度，远慢于机构布局的速度。

3. **$BTC 和 $ETH 的“躺平”不是终点，而是分化起点**：比特币在6.3万缩量震荡，以太坊还在等ETF资金注入。但AI赛道已经出现了“Perps+预测市场”的新玩法——加密原生的金融工具，正在为AI计算资源定价。

**预测**：未来3个月，如果比特币无法站稳7万并放量突破，资金将进一步向AI+DePIN等新叙事迁移。不要跟趋势作对，但也不要因为短期数据恐慌——6.3万的比特币，比85000的“AI概念币”更安全，前提是你有耐心。

第一，你说ETH在震荡整理，24小时就涨了0.6%，7天也就2.7%。这点涨幅算什么？说难听点，连个像样的反弹都算不上。但问题来了——成交量呢？低得可怜。市场现在就是这个状态：想买的人不敢买，想卖的人不想割，大家都在等。等什么？等一个信号，等成交量放出来，等方向明确。这种时候，最忌讳的就是提前站队。

第二，你说FNG指数25，极度恐惧。这东西我2017年就见过，市场恐慌到极致的时候，反而是见底的征兆。历史不会简单重复，但人性从来没变过。当所有人都在害怕，当所有媒体都在渲染绝望，反而说明抛压已经释放得差不多了。但注意，恐慌归恐慌，我说的是"可能见底"，不是说"已经见底"。这两个有本质区别。
